description: How many BeginTrans levels does one Workspace accept, and which levels are still there afterwards? Eight times: Workspaces(0).BeginTrans, then UPDATE T SET V = 100 + level WHERE ID = 4 (dbFailOnError). Then nine times: Rollback, read DBEngine.Errors, read T through a new snapshot. Row 4 after each Rollback shows which level is current; T is then read through a fresh Workspace.
retentionNote: Designed r-txn-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
